messages.subject: Vectorized Poisson Error
parts:
Hi everyone,

This is a relatively simple question and hopefully is a simple answer. I am trying to sample using a vectorized poisson to see if it will speed my model up. I have gotten the distribution function correct but it seems that I have the random generation function incorrect. Could someone look this code over and see if there are any errors?

# Vectorized poisson
dpois_vec <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(x = double(1),
                 lambda = double(1),
                 log = integer(0, default = 0)){
    returnType(double(0))
    logProb <- sum(dpois(x, lambda, log = TRUE))
    if(log) return(logProb)
    else return(exp(logProb))
  }
)

# Random generation
rpois_vec <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(n = integer(0, default = 1),
                 lambda = double(1)){
    returnType(double(1))
    return(rpois(length(lambda), lambda))
  }
)

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: Vectorized Poisson Error
parts:
If you just compile `rpois_vec` and run it, it should work fine - I just tried it.
So I think the question is why you're getting unexpected behavior in the model. It may have to do with model initialization.

I would try using `simulate` directly with the compiled model and see what happens in terms of the values of J, Y, A, etc. and their logProb values. On a related note, we have suggestions here on how to debug model initialization.

-chris
